notes.title: Speedrunner update!
notes.notes:
We are including in the game package the original game DOS files alongside DosBox that were previously available.

You should find the new folder under your game installation directory.
For Windows: \Speedrun\Windows you can launch the game with LaunchLBA2.bat
For Mac: \Speedrun\Mac\Contents\MacOS you can launch the game with the Launcher script

Happy speedruns, and thank you for your patience.

notes.title: 25th Anniversary Update
notes.notes:
We are super happy to announce that the updated version of Twinsen's Little Big Adventure 2 Classic is now available on Steam!

[h2]The content of the update
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Language select in menu
[*] Steam Achievements
[*] Steam Cloud Saving
[*] Controller Support
[*] Input remapping
[*] New Game+
[*] Windowed Support
[*] [b]Auto-centered camera in exteriors setting on/off[/b]
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: 25th anniversary update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone. To celebrate the 25th anniversary of Twinsen’s Little Big Adventure 2 Classic we’ve made some welcome updates to the game! We hope you will enjoy this first update in 25 years!

[list]
[*] New Game+ Mode: start the story with end-game items like the Emperor Sword, Blowtron and Magic Level 4
[*] An improved Auto Centered Camera for exterior environments
[*] Steam Achievements: try to unlock them all!
[*] Controller support and input remapping: play the game with the controller of your choice and remap the input to your liking
[*] Steam Cloud Saving
[*] Language selection
[*] Windowed Support
[/list]
- Team 2.21
